description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page named TakenCourses. It handles page load events and button click events that transfer the user to different pages within the online examination system.

classes.name: TakenCourses
classes.description: A partial class representing the code-behind for the TakenCourses.aspx page, managing navigation through button click events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the event when the page loads; currently does not perform any actions.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event of the home button, transferring the user to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event of the profile button, transferring the user to the UserProfile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event of the leaderboard button, transferring the user to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event of the logout button, transferring the user to the LoginPage.
